faculty.acidemia: no pH arrest threshold unless a committed common rule exists; the P2K-5 / P2L-2 subset (57m, demand 1.1, 17,604 rows, pH < 7.00) carried as a diagnostic stress subset, never filtered
faculty.brief: P2M-1 collapse / arrest safety architecture audit (2026-11-02): structural; no arrest threshold chosen
faculty.candidate_domains: A flow, B MAP / perfusion pressure, C pump P, D rhythm / pulse R, E effective oxygen delivery / deficit, F arterial oxygenation, G severe acid-base failure, H future respiratory failure; necessity, redundancy and order to be determined
faculty.closed: BloodState, V, P, T, R, pressure, DO2 / deficit, D, lactate, HR / baroreflex, acid-base, RR / W / PaCO2 and the consciousness architecture closed; P2L-2's carried debts untouched unless collapse depends on them
faculty.no_biomarker_arrest: lactate, D alone, consciousness I and the systemic encephalopathy burden F are never direct collapse or arrest triggers
faculty.order: no implicit recursive pulse / collapse feedback; an explicit lag if needed
faculty.persistence: if an instantaneous rule would flip or arrest in one minute: PERSISTENCE_STATE_OR_TIMER_REQUIRED; D and F are not collapse memory without strong causal justification
faculty.rosc: no ACLS here; no proposed state may make a future return of circulation impossible
faculty.scope: shadow only; no collapse activation, runtime integration, GI or second-family migration, death model or parameter approval
faculty.three_states: consciousness impairment, hemodynamic collapse (circulation present, not viable) and cardiac arrest (no effective circulation) stay distinct; unconscious with a pulse, profound shock with a pulse and collapse progressing to arrest stay representable
faculty.thresholds: the GI cases cannot identify minimum viable MAP or flow, an arrest pH or DO2 or a persistence duration; ranges only from general physiology, otherwise UNSET

anaphylaxis: T and V fall, airway: MAP first, flow later, hypoxaemia
cardiogenic: P falls: flow, MAP and delivery fall
distributive_sepsis: T falls: MAP falls while flow is kept or rises; demand rises
yes (perfusion pressure; demand through the deficit)
hemorrhagic: V and Hb fall: flow, MAP and delivery fall together
hypoxaemia_respiratory_failure: SpO2 falls; the systemic deficit (extraction reserve) misses it to about 39 %; apnoea needs the respiratory family's writer
yes with arterial oxygenation; apnoea is the family's writer
malignant_arrhythmia: a pulseless rhythm is arrest at once (a rhythm transition, not collapse); a perfusing low-output rhythm lowers flow
pulseless: not collapse; with a pulse: yes
obstructive_pe: no obstruction channel: the family's writer lowers effective preload / pump; PE adds hypoxaemia
yes for the flow part, no for the hypoxaemia

bicarbonate_guard: an acid burden that takes HCO3 to or below 0 stops the run
blood_channel_guard: a blood-state move outside the V / Hb guard stops the run
hemodynamic_collapse_with_pulse: no observable or state names a collapse while a pulse is present; only the hidden P2E-3 burden exists, and only when the rule is declared
legacy_engine_arrests: family_engine and its family modules (read as text)
anaphylaxis untreated minutes, apnoea minutes, a closed coronary artery's minutes to VF, a bradycardia rate at or below 20, and the older generic low-flow conjunction in clinical_physiology
no_return_of_pulse: a transition back to a pulse after arrest raises ('resuscitation is out of scope'); terminal_since never cleared
p2e3_collapse_rule: aux.collapse_burden accrues the share by which output_rel falls below a declared threshold (read on the minute's start state, only with a pulse), held or repaid when declared; at the declared limit R moves to PEA (or asystole) the same step, so the new state is pulseless one minute after the state that met the criterion; off by default (threshold and limit None)
resuscitation_rosc: no CPR, defibrillation, epinephrine-for-arrest or return of circulation
rhythm_state_invariants: a pulse exactly when the rhythm perfuses; a non-perfusing rhythm has no output
scripted_pump_change: a declared change of P per minute over an interval; reaches flow, never the pulse directly
scripted_rhythm_event: a declared natural-history change of R at a declared minute, cause class and preventability; not applied once in arrest; no GI case declares one
zero_output_guard: a pulse with effective output at the numerical zero stops the run (UnresolvedBoundary), it is never shown

design.migration_gate: MIGRATION_GATE_CLOSED: no collapse activation, numeric collapse filtering, arrest threshold, ROSC / ACLS, runtime integration, GI or second-family migration is authorized

minimum.invariants: a persistence floor (no one-minute arrest: the limit above one minute's maximal accrual) and a mandatory repayment whenever the rule is declared
minimum.new: one derived common non-viability signal replacing output_rel as the burden's input: the maximum (never a sum) of perfusion-pressure failure (MAP), oxygen-delivery failure (the effective deficit) and, if the faculty decides, arterial-oxygenation failure (SpO2), with the dominant mechanism recorded (CIRCULATORY_COLLAPSE / METABOLIC_NONVIABILITY_RISK)
minimum.not_added_here: nothing is implemented, activated or valued in P2M-1
minimum.not_needed: no new collapse state, no timer beside the burden, no pump or rhythm input, no flow input, no pH, lactate, D, I or F input
minimum.reuse: the P2E-3 structure: aux.collapse_burden (a dedicated persistence memory, neither D nor F), its explicit one-minute lag, the terminal transition to a pulseless rhythm and the CO1 / CO2 rules

design.policy: Shadow only and read-only: no core file, channel, rule, threshold or parameter changed or added; fixed core states, P2E-3's committed synthetic test values and committed records read with pinned hashes; the legacy engine quoted as text, never imported or fitted; the extreme subset kept; nothing selected, approved or activated.
design.probe_rule: Fixed states on P2K-2's neutral probe arrival (bands.ARRIVAL with HCO3 20, extraction reserve 2.5), read through derive, the deficit and the ventilation candidate (gain 0.04): illustrative extremes, P2L-1's sizes where they exist. Each candidate input is classified threshold-free against the neutral reference: zero under every admissible bound (the reading is on the reference's side), or positive under some. The current P2E-3 input is output_rel, whose admissible thresholds lie below arrival output (1).

flow_A_low_flow_high_tone: pump 0.55, tone 3.0 (the tone guard's ceiling): low flow, MAP kept
oxygen_E_arterial_hypoxaemia: arrival on FiO2 1, then room air (SpO2 73)
pump_B_rhythm_low_output_with_pulse: complete AV block at 30 / min, output factor 0.5, pump 1

pulse_semantics.changed_by: a RhythmTransition: a contributor's (modules/rhythm_events.ScriptedRhythmEvent) or the core's P2E-3 collapse rule (integration.step); the arrival constructor sets the arrival rhythm
pulse_semantics.class: AUTHORITATIVE_STATE: pulse is a field of the rhythm state R, changed only by rhythm transitions; it is bound by invariant to the rhythm code (pulse exactly when the code perfuses: NON_PERFUSING = pulseless VT, VF, PEA, asystole), so it is ELECTRICAL / RHYTHM semantics, never read from pressure or flow
pulse_semantics.default: the case's arrival rhythm (Anchors.rhythm; bands.ARRIVAL: sinus 80, pulse); terminal_since None
pulse_semantics.field: CoreState.R (channel C4, 'state machine: code, rate, effective-output factor, pulse'): RhythmState.pulse_present
pulse_semantics.invariants: a perfusing rhythm has output_factor > 0, a pulseless one exactly 0; terminal_since is set exactly when there is no pulse, within the encounter, and never cleared
pulse_semantics.when_false: derive's pulseless branch: output, pressure and delivery 0; SBP, DBP, MAP, SpO2, CRT and pulse rate not measurable; RR 0; the legacy level 3; the integrator keeps T and P as latent values, accrues D at the full demand (lactate follows it a minute later), accrues the acid burden, holds the collapse burden; nothing restores a pulse

ranges.existing_committed_candidates: the P2F calibration registry (CANDIDATE, not approved): burden per minute 0.5 / 1 / 2, limit 5 / 15 / 30 minutes at full severity, repayment 30 / 60 / 240 min; the output threshold 0.2 / 0.3 / 0.4 belongs to the output input the minimum replaces
ranges.unset: the bounds of the perfusion-pressure, oxygen-delivery and arterial-oxygenation failure signals, the persistence floor, the terminal-rhythm selection rule: no committed common range; never from the GI cases

redundancy.A_flow: REDUNDANT_GIVEN_B_AND_E: flow reaches viability through perfusion pressure (pressure = flow x tone) and through delivery (delivery = flow x content); a low flow that neither lowers MAP nor exhausts extraction is not by itself non-viable
redundancy.B_perfusion_pressure: NECESSARY: vasoplegia keeps flow and delivery while MAP falls (flow_B); only pressure sees it
redundancy.C_pump: REDUNDANT_VIA_FLOW: P enters output multiplicatively; reading it beside its consequences counts it twice
redundancy.D_rhythm: SPLIT: a pulseless rhythm is arrest itself (a transition, not collapse); a perfusing rhythm's output factor enters flow like P
redundancy.E_oxygen_delivery: NECESSARY: an oxygen-content failure keeps flow and MAP (oxygen_B); only the deficit sees it
redundancy.F_arterial_oxygenation: DISTINCT_CANDIDATE: the systemic deficit misses arterial hypoxaemia to about 39 % at normal flow and Hb (oxygen_E); the myocardium extracts near its maximum at rest, so a separate input is plausible: faculty decision
redundancy.G_acid_base: MODIFIER_NOT_INPUT: no path to P or R today; the acid burden integrates the deficit (P2L-2 M4), so an additive pH input would recount a prolonged deficit; amplifier or myocardial depression are later decisions
redundancy.H_respiratory_failure: FUTURE: no apnoea or ventilatory-failure writer; it reaches viability through SpO2
redundancy.lactate_D_I_F: EXCLUDED (faculty): consequences and markers, never triggers

status.probe_values: SYNTHETIC_PROBE_ONLY: illustrative fixed states (P2L-1's sizes) and P2E-3's committed synthetic test values (threshold 0.4, limit 10, repayment tau 30)

design.verdict_rule: Predeclared. READY iff every criterion holds; otherwise NOT_READY - the first failing criterion as the blocker, every failing criterion listed. A changed upstream file stops the run before any probe.

event_order.classification: EXPLICIT_LAG_REQUIRED: already implemented (the criterion is read on the minute's start state, the pulseless rhythm is the next state's; the detector never reads its own result in the same step, needs a pulse to fire and freezes after arrest): ACYCLIC

extreme_subset.P: 1 (arrival): the untreated GI scenario writes no pump change (modules/gi_haemorrhage writes the blood state only)
extreme_subset.R: sinus with a pulse: no rhythm transition is declared and the collapse rule is off
extreme_subset.bounds_reading: output_rel at minute 120 lies between the effective delivery over the largest arrival delivery ratio (Hb ratio at most 1) and the pressure the MAP implies (tone at least 1 under the tone response); not reconstructed: the structural conclusion does not depend on it
extreme_subset.missing_safety_mechanism: ACTIVE_COMMON_COLLAPSE_RULE_MISSING: the P2E-3 structure exists but is off and reads output only; with it off, MAP 31-46 mmHg, a deficit of 0.84 and pH 6.96 keep a pulse until a guard stops the run (zero output, HCO3 at 0, blood bounds), never an arrest
extreme_subset.spo2: 97 (authored arrival; untreated FiO2 unchanged, and SpO2 moves only with FiO2)

zero_flow.reading: pulse=false can never carry flow, pressure or delivery (the rhythm invariant and derive's pulseless branch); pulse=true with output at the numerical zero is not representable (the run stops), but pulse=true with output 0.02 is: MAP about 2 mmHg with a pulse, because the pulse is rhythm semantics and nothing reads pressure to end it while the collapse rule is off
